standard.summary: 仅 orthogonal_redistribute 使用：center_peak=中间层更高；ascending=深层更高；descending=浅层更高；flat=平坦。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Used by orthogonal_redistribute only: center_peak = higher in the middle layers; ascending = higher deeper; descending = higher shallower; flat = level.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.center_peak: High rank in the middle layers.

advanced.principle: 仅 orthogonal_redistribute 使用：center_peak=中间层更高；ascending=深层更高；descending=浅层更高；flat=平坦。

advanced_en.principle: Only used by orthogonal_redistribute: center_peak = middle layers higher; ascending = deeper layers higher; descending = shallower layers higher; flat = uniform.
